name: financeflow
description: FinanceFlow - Plataforma Web de Gestão Financeira Pessoal (full stack TypeScript). Raiz do monorepo: orquestra backend e frontend.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run db:migrate && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run quality:duplication
